visibleLinksAndButtons.text: 01 / Shingle surfaceThe outer shingle layer forms the roof’s visible weather-shedding surface.
02 / Roof sheathingSheathing creates a continuous deck beneath the roof covering.
03 / Roof framingTimber framing gives the roof its shape and structural support.
04 / Gutter systemGutters collect roof runoff and direct it toward downspouts.
